source_note: 满足这种函数极限性质的函数是几乎处处为0的
english_source_note: Such a Limit Property Forces a Function to Vanish a.e.
callout_id: 满足这种函数极限性质的函数是几乎处处为0的#1
statement_en: Let $f:[0,1]\to \mathbb{R}$ satisfy that for every $x_0 \in [0,1]$, one has $\lim_{x\to x_0} f(x)=0$. Then $f=0$ almost everywhere.
key_techniques: contradiction via the definition of limit
prerequisites: definition of limit of a function
callout_body: 函数$f:[0,1]\to \mathbb{R}$满足对任意$\forall x_0 \in [0,1]$都有$\lim_{x\to x_0}f(x)=0$那么函数几乎处处为0.
